title: Test first: the Midori card also shows phone push; then show it
goal: The card shows the phone push line: subscribed devices, last push delivered, last push opened (from the receipts B-170 records), in plain words and in Eva voice
acceptance: A failing test first (test/dashboard-live-views.test.mjs): a base card with push status shows 'N devices', the last delivery result and time, and the last open time or 'not opened yet'; with no device it says so

Own base only (push is local to a base); the line sits beside the Telegram lines in channelLine, no backlog IDs in text, wording in both voices (plain and Eva), phone width keeps it on its own wrapped line
The doctor push status (src/store-push.ts status()) gains the last opened time from delivery_channels.opened_at; a test across store and card
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 from the existing code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
